c74object.name: gst.acc.intensity
c74object.digest: Acceleration intensity from raw data stream from accelerometer [list]
c74object.description:
gst.acc.intensity calculates the acceleration intensity from the raw accelerometer data stream.
The derivation and integration processes are applied with a pre or post normalization (mean or root of sum of squares).
Uses pipo.intensity of MuBu package from ISMM team
at IRCAM Centre Pompidou http://ismm.ircam.fr/pipo/

inlet.digest: cutoff frenquency [float] in Hz of the integral filter.
inlet.description: cutoff frenquency fc [float] in Hz of the integral filter coresponding to the feedback integration. It is a 1st order IIR lowpass filter (onepole) : y[n]=bx[n]+(1-b)*y[n-1]. b = W/(W+1) with normalized frequency W = fc/FR (FR is frame rate known as sample rate).

outlet.digest: computed accelerometer intensity on X axis.
computed accelerometer intensity on Y axis.
computed accelerometer intensity on Z axis.

attribute.name: bounds
attribute.digest: list [float float] specifying min max display
attribute.description: list [float float] specifying min max display of mubu.scroll object

attribute.name: framerate
attribute.description: frame rate [float] in Hz for pipo.intensity object.

attribute.name: intensity.cutfrequency
attribute.digest: cutoff frenquency [float] in Hz of the integral filter.
attribute.description: cutoff frenquency fc [float] in Hz of the integral filter coresponding to the feedback integration. It is a 1st order IIR lowpass filter (onepole) : y[n]=bx[n]+(1-b)*y[n-1]. b = W/(W+1) with normalized frequency W = fc/FR (FR is frame rate known as sample rate).

attribute.name: intensity.powerexp
attribute.description: power function is applied on the computed intensity y[n]=x[n]^factor. 0.<factor<1. is compression. factor>1. is expansion.

attribute.name: intensity.offsetvalue
attribute.description: A linear amount is substracted to behave as a gate. A gain compensation may be necessary (intensity.gain).

attribute.name: intensity.movingaveragesize
attribute.description: optional average prefiltering if >1. See pipo.mvavrg from MuBu package.

attribute.name: intensity.deltasize
attribute.description: windowsize for derivation. Minimum is 3. It computes the derivative on a predefined windoaw size. See pipo.delta from MuBu package.

attribute.name: intensity.mode
attribute.description: Input triplet of floats could be absolute (0), positive (1), negative (2) or square (3).

attribute.name: intensity.normmode
attribute.description:
Normalization applied pre or post derivation and integration processes.
L2pre (0), L2post (1), meanpre (2) or meanpost (3).
L2 is the √(x^2+y^2+z^2).
mean is (x+y+z)/3.
